model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of a latch in which lever position relative to a pawl determines whether lever actuation releases a ratchet.

subsystems.description: Retains a latched position through releasable engagement with the pawl; may move to an unlatched position when disengaged.
Releasably engages the ratchet and is moved by lever action to permit ratchet disengagement.

interfaces.interface_type: Pawl post received in lever aperture; lost motion is permitted, with force transfer when the aperture surface contacts the post during release.

subsystems.description: Moves between positions relative to the pawl and pivots; in the release-enabled position it transfers force to the pawl, while in the other position actuation cannot release the ratchet.
One alternative, embodiment-dependent positioning arrangement: a rotatable element coupled to the lever, whose rotation moves the lever between positions relative to the pawl.

Alternative, embodiment-dependent over-center positioning arrangement (not necessarily combined with the rotatable-element arrangement). It moves the lever between locked and unlocked positions across an unstable center position, with at least two stable positions on either side.
External user-manipulatable device serving as a source of a latch-release input; the patent does not specify its particular output kinematics or coupling.

interfaces.interface_type: User-manipulatable latch-release input; specific coupling kinematics unspecified

item_flows.name: Lever actuation
item_flows.notes: User-manipulatable input for generating latch release; specific input-device output kinematics are not specified.

item_flows.name: Lever-to-pawl force and motion
item_flows.notes: Transferred through lever/pawl engagement; aperture receives pawl post and permits lost motion.

item_flows.name: Lever positioning motion
item_flows.notes: Movement of the lever relative to the pawl, driven by a rotatable element or, in an alternative embodiment, an over-center device.

item_flows.name: Ratchet-pawl engagement
item_flows.notes: Releasable engagement retains the ratchet in its latched position; disengagement permits release.

steps.description: Rotate the coupled positioning element toward the unlocked position.
Move the lever relative to the pawl into a position where it can transmit sufficient force for release.
Pivot the lever in the release-enabled position.
Lever aperture bears on the pawl post and moves the pawl out of ratchet engagement.
The ratchet is no longer retained in its latched position.
